en: A vintage black‑and‑white (sepia-toned) postcard view of a small European town with a river in the foreground spanned by an arched bridge. Traditional multi‑story houses line the riverside, and a church with a tall, slender steeple rises above the rooftops on the left. In the background are tree‑covered hills with scattered villas. The caption at the bottom center reads "Lunzenau (Mulde)".
